test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The teacher did not allow the students to leave the lecture.

options.text: The students are not allowed to leave the lecture.
The students had not been allowed to leave the lecture by the teacher.
The students had not allowed the teacher to leave the lecture.
The students were not allowed to leave the lecture by the teacher.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The students were not allowed to leave the lecture by the teacher.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
